title: Narcooo/inkos

zh.gap: 现有工具第一步是装 Node、改配置、挑模型；熬过去的人发现 20 万字之后章节字数控制不住，每本书的开局都长一个样。

voices.quote: 大家没有发现这个问题吗？多开几本同类型的小说，比如：玄幻，你会发现主角开局要么下坑要么下矿要么捡垃圾，接着有个对他怀恨在心的npc张虎或者其他，再来一个对他好的老头吧啦吧啦，说实话去除人名，这些故事几乎一样。发散性严重不足。

zh.pain: 写到第四章，字数开始失控，主角又一次掉进矿洞——AI 帮你写小说，写出来的还是那本谁都写过的书。
zh.kill: 「写出来都一样」不是能修的 bug，是模型连写三百章的必然结果；而番茄、起点正在给站内写手直接发自家助手，后面连着分发和稿费。
zh.move: 别做流水线，做稿子：一键安装、模型预置，只承诺两件事——20 万字不崩、每章字数就是你要的那个数；写到开局就提醒你「又是矿洞」。

gap: Only geeks can use it, and the output still reads like filler. The person who wants this is a web-novel writer, not a Node developer: they must install Node 20+, hand-edit a .env, and pick a model provider before the first sentence — and the ones who get through report chapters that lose word-count control and plots that converge on the same opening.
pain: Someone who wants to finish a web novel, not someone who wants to run an npm package: 8.7k stars and 1.6k forks say the appetite is real, and the issue tracker says the writer is stuck at chapter four.
kill: The sameness complaint is not a bug you can patch — it is what a language model does when you ask it for 300 chapters, and every competitor will hit the same wall. Meanwhile Chinese platforms (番茄/起点) are shipping their own authoring assistants to the writers who already live there, with the distribution and the payout attached. A tool that makes bad novels faster has no buyer.
move: Do not ship a pipeline; ship a manuscript. One-click desktop install with a model key pre-wired, and the product's promise is narrowed to the single job the issue tracker proves is broken: keep a 200k-character story consistent and keep each chapter at the length the writer asked for. Sell the divergence, not the volume — a 'sameness check' that flags when chapter one is drifting into the same mine-shaft opening as everyone else's. Cold start (Chinese): the inkos issue tracker itself plus 番茄小说作者交流 and 龙的天空 forums, where writers post exactly these complaints; Cold start (English): r/WritingWithAI and r/HFY, search 'lost the plot chapter'.
